# Audioengine A2+ Gen 3 — Bluetooth Desktop Speakers

**Category:** Computer/Desktop Speakers

**MSRP:** $279

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Type | Powered Bluetooth aptX-Adaptive speaker system (2.0 channel) |
| Amplifier Type | Class D |
| Rated Power Output | 20W RMS per channel at 4 ohms |
| Peak Power Output | 30W per channel at 4 ohms (AES); 60W total peak |
| Drivers | 2.75" aramid fiber woofers, 0.75" silk dome tweeters |
| Inputs | 3.5mm stereo mini-jack, RCA L/R, USB-C, Bluetooth |
| Outputs | RCA variable line-out (for subwoofer) |
| Frequency Response | 65Hz–22kHz ±2.0dB |
| SNR | >95 dB (typical A-weighted) |
| THD+N | <0.05% at all power settings |
| Crosstalk | <50 dB |
| Bluetooth Receiver | Qualcomm QCC 3034, Bluetooth 5.3 |
| Supported Codecs | aptX-Adaptive, aptX-HD, aptX, AAC, SBC |
| Bluetooth Range | Up to 100 ft (30 m) typical |
| Wireless Latency | ~120 ms |
| USB Connector | USB-C, 24-bit (padded), 44.1/48/96 kHz |
| Internal DAC | PCM5100A |
| Input Voltage | 100–240V 50/60Hz auto-switching |
| Dimensions (each) | 6" x 4" x 5.25" (15.6 x 10.6 x 13.8 cm) |
| Weight | Left (active) 3.6 lb / Right (passive) 3.2 lb |
| Colors | Black, White, Red (high-gloss) |

## Notable Features

- Bluetooth 5.3 with aptX-Adaptive support delivers up to 3x the range of standard Bluetooth with no audio quality loss
- Custom-designed and manufactured aramid fiber woofers and silk dome tweeters
- RCA variable line-out for easy subwoofer addition (e.g., Audioengine S6)
- Thick, internally braced MDF cabinets with rounded edges to reduce resonance and diffraction
- Auto-idle power-saving mode so the speakers can be left powered on continuously
- No drivers or software required — works out of the box on Mac, PC, and most mobile devices via USB or Bluetooth
